artworks.title: Moth, Three Butterflies, and Two Beetles
artworks.description: The image features four butterflies and two beetles. The central butterfly has large, ornate wings with eye-like patterns in the top center. Two butterflies with wings folded stand on either side, while one in the bottom center has its wings open. Two small beetles are positioned near the upper sides. The artwork is in black and white with intricate line work for texture and detail.

artworks.title: Dragonflies, a Bumble-Bee, and a Butterfly
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various insects. The image showcases a collection of insects in a detailed and richly textured manner, with each insect depicted carefully. The insects are arranged in a visually engaging composition that highlights their diversity in form and size. Among them, a large grasshopper-like insect is at the center with expansive wings, while a dragonfly with elongated wings is nearby, with other insects filling the remaining space in the illustration.

artworks.title: Two Butterflies, a Wasp, and a Moth
artworks.description: The image features four insects. The largest is a butterfly with broad striped wings, positioned centrally. Below it, there are three smaller insects - another butterfly on the left with a spotted pattern, a wasp-like insect in the middle, and a third butterfly on the right with a mix of spotted and striped patterns on its wings. The color palette is monochrome, consisting of various shades of black and white. The insects are symmetrically arranged, with the largest butterfly at the top center and the smaller creatures lined up at the bottom horizontally.

artworks.title: Two Moths and Six Insects
artworks.description: Two large moths are positioned centrally in the image, one facing north at the top and the other facing south at the bottom. The color palette consists of black and white, as it is a monochrome illustration. Around the moths, there are smaller insects, including a small moth on the left, a bee below it, another small moth on the right, and beetles positioned at the top left and bottom right corners.

artworks.title: Three Moths, Two Butterflies, and a Bumble Bee
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various insect illustrations. The drawing features detailed representations of different insects, including a bumblebee and several butterflies and moths. Each insect is depicted with meticulous line work, emphasizing their patterns and wing structures. The insects are arranged in a scattered manner across the page, showcasing a variety of wing shapes and sizes. The upper left corner prominently features a bumblebee with its characteristic fuzzy body and delicate wings, while the surrounding area includes intricately patterned butterflies and moths, each with distinct markings on their wings. The style suggests an emphasis on naturalistic detail.

artworks.title: Four Butterflies
artworks.description: The image displays four butterflies with different patterns and positions on a plain gray backdrop. The butterflies vary in wing positions and are distinguished by their unique patterns. The color palette consists of various shades of gray. Each butterfly is positioned differently on the backdrop, with one in profile and three with wings open. The artwork is titled and signed in the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Five Butterflies, a Moth, a Beetle, and a Spider
artworks.description: The image shows an arrangement of six butterflies and two beetles. The largest butterfly is positioned centrally at the top, showcasing detailed striped wing patterns. The color palette is monochromatic, consisting solely of black and white shading. Flanking the central butterfly are two smaller butterflies on either side, each with unique patterns, and a smaller beetle is located near the top corners. Beneath the central butterfly, there is a moth with a distinctive dotted pattern and two additional butterflies on either side with different wing shapes and markings.

artworks.title: Three Butterflies and Two Moths
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various butterflies. The detailed etching features five distinct butterflies with unique patterns and shapes on their wings. The butterflies are arranged to fill the space effectively, showcasing the diversity and beauty of their forms. The central butterfly has large, expansive wings with prominent stripes and spots. Surrounding it are other butterflies, each noted for specific wing patterns, such as polka dots and bands. The illustration exhibits careful attention to detail, highlighting the artist's dedication to accurately capturing the intricacies of the butterflies.

artworks.title: Title Page
artworks.description: The image shows two large butterflies with four smaller ones inside a bordered area featuring ornate scrollwork and text. The colors are monochromatic in shades of black, white, and gray. A large butterfly is in the lower-left corner, and another in the lower-right corner, each with circular patterns on their wings. Two smaller butterflies are at the top, and another smaller butterfly is near the center bottom. Text is centrally positioned with embellishments above and below.

artworks.title: Two Dragonflies and Five Butterflies
artworks.description: The image contains six insects - a dragonfly, three butterflies, a moth, and a beetle. The dragonfly is at the lower left and center, the butterflies at the top, the moth on the right near the dragonfly, and the beetle at the lower right. The color scheme is monochromatic with black lines and shading on a beige background.

artworks.title: Swallow-tailed Butterfly and Twelve Other Insects
artworks.description: The image shows a large butterfly with black and white striped patterns on its wings surrounded by smaller insects, including butterflies, bees, beetles, and other insects. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of black and grey against a beige background. The central butterfly is in the middle, with other insects positioned around it.

artworks.title: Three Caterpillars, a Moth, and Four Butterflies
artworks.description: The image shows various insects. A large moth is at the center with outstretched wings. Above is a segmented caterpillar with circular patterns, and to the right is a fluffy, curled-up caterpillar. On the left side, a butterfly is in flight, and in the bottom right corner, another butterfly is perched on a surface. To the right of the central moth, there is a shell-like creature with stripes. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of black and white. The insects are arranged in an orderly manner within the frame, with the largest moth positioned centrally and surrounded by other insects evenly spaced throughout the composition.

artworks.title: Moth, Butterflies, and Bees
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various insects. The drawing contains meticulously detailed insects such as butterflies, moths, beetles, and other small winged creatures. These insects are arranged symmetrically, with a large moth at the center. The surrounding insects display unique wing patterns and structures. The artist used fine lines and cross-hatching techniques to emphasize the details and textures of the insects' bodies and wings.

artworks.title: Six Insects, a Caterpillar, and a Snail
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various insects and a snail. The image depicts a neatly arranged selection of insects, a snail, and a caterpillar. The drawing includes three prominently displayed moths or butterflies, each showcasing different patterns on their wings. In the top part of the drawing, there is a detailed snail with its shell spirals and antennae extended, placed above a furry caterpillar. On the left and right edges, there are two smaller butterflies or moths with distinct markings. The entire arrangement is enclosed within a rectangular border. The drawing is rendered with fine lines, which emphasizes the textures and details of the insects and the snail.

artworks.title: Five Butterflies and a Moth
artworks.description: The image contains six detailed illustrations of butterflies arranged in two rows. The two largest butterflies are positioned at the top left and top right, with their wings displaying dark and light stripes. The color palette is monochrome, primarily black and white. In the first row, a wider butterfly with a spotted pattern occupies the center, flanked by the two striped butterflies. In the second row, three smaller butterflies are depicted with different patterns: one with eye-like spots, one delicate with subtle markings, and one with smaller spots. The arrangement showcases the distinctive wing patterns of each butterfly.

artworks.title: Dragonfly, Ladybirds, and Butterflies
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various insects, including butterflies, moths, a dragonfly, and other small creatures. The central focus of the drawing is a large dragonfly, with detailed, intricately patterned wings and segmented body, showing a fine network of lines. Surrounding the dragonfly are multiple species of butterflies and moths, each depicted with distinct wing patterns and markings, showcasing a diversity of designs. In addition to the larger insects, there are smaller creatures depicted with precise detail. The background is a plain, unadorned surface, emphasizing the focus on the detailed illustration of each insect.

artworks.title: Theatrum mulierum: Title Page
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a printed title page. The image shows a historical title page featuring a stylized typographic design and an emblem. The text is presented in an old-style serif font with all capital letters spelling "THEATRUM MULIERUM" and other Latin phrases. Below the main text is a small coat of arms marked with "W. H," and the word "LONDON" is printed beneath it, along with a note indicating it was printed by Peter Stent.

artworks.title: Aula Veneris: Title Page
artworks.description: The image shows a rectangular frame with text inside, a cherub above it holding an arrow and bow. The color scheme includes sepia and off-white. Below the text frame is a grouping of items like boxes and fabrics.

artworks.title: Nobilis Mulier Bohemica
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing upright. She has a calm expression, delicate facial features, and is wearing a large fur hat. She is dressed in elaborate attire with a layered gown, fur-trimmed cloak, and flat shoes. The background is plain, and there is text in German at the top of the image. The artwork resembles an etching or engraving from the 17th century, with a signature and date at the bottom left.

artworks.title: Rustica Bohemica
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length depiction of a person standing upright. The individual is wearing a long, layered outfit that includes a cloak with fur or textured trimmings that falls to the ground. The person's face is visible, showing delicate features with a subtle expression, and their hair is mostly covered by a snug, conical hat. Wrapped around their neck is a soft, large scarf or shawl, adding to the layered appearance. Their clothing includes intricate designs near the bottom, suggesting a pattern or embroidery on a garment beneath the cloak. The person is holding an object clasped in front of their waist. The background is plain and unadorned. The words "Rustica Bohemica" are inscribed beneath the figure.

artworks.title: Mercatoris Pragensis Vxor
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body profile view of a person standing and facing right. The individual is dressed in historical attire, wearing a tall, conical hat, a ruffled collar, and a long, fur-lined cloak. Their feet are covered by simple shoes or boots. The background is plain with some texture. Text at the top and bottom of the image offers context.

artworks.title: Mulier Pragensis
artworks.description: The image shows a woman in profile, with detailed facial features, wearing a long gown, a wide-brimmed hat, and a capelet with a ruffled collar. She has neatly styled hair and is standing against a plain background.

artworks.title: Ciuis Pragensis Filia
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing upright, facing slightly to the right. She has a composed expression with distinct features including a straight nose and subtle eyebrows. Her hair is styled back with a patterned headband. She is wearing a decorated robe with a ruffled collar, and a fur-trimmed outer garment. There are no visible accessories in her hands. The background is plain. Text is present above the woman's head and at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Mulier Austriae Superioris
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing in a posed position. She faces forward with her hands delicately positioned in front of her body. Her facial features include a serene expression, with finely arched eyebrows and closed lips. Her hairstyle is neat, with her hair pulled back into a bun. She is dressed in period attire consisting of a long dress with an elaborate ruffled collar, a fur-lined cape, and a voluminous skirt. The gown drapes down to her feet, where pointed shoes are visible. There are no visible jewelry pieces or objects she is holding. The background is plain, and the image is bordered by a margin containing text at the bottom that reads "Mulier Austriæ superioris," along with small text indicating the artist and date.
